item1.title: Web System for Statistical Analysis
item1.subtitle: High School Project
item1.description: Together with a team of three people, a web system was designed and developed focused on analyzing prices and demand in a supermarket chain, using statistical tools to facilitate business decision-making
item1.longDescription:
Web-based statistical analysis system designed to evaluate retail pricing trends and demand forecasting for supermarkets:

• Price & Demand Modeling: Statistical algorithms calculating demand elasticity and shopping trends across commercial categories.
• Relational MySQL Engine: High-performance relational schema handling large volumes of checkout and pricing transactions.
• Dynamic Query Interface: Multi-level filtering across supermarket aisles, seasonal periods, and profit margin distributions.
• Laravel MVC Architecture: Robust backend architecture cleanly separating business logic, database transactions, and user views.

item2.title: Inventory and Billing Web System
item2.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Application
item2.description: This comprehensive web system automates inventory management and billing for businesses, providing detailed sales reports and statistics. It integrates key processes through AI automation.
item2.longDescription:
Comprehensive full-stack web system engineered to streamline warehouse operations, inventory tracking, and corporate billing:

• AI-Driven Automation: Integration of intelligent agents and automated n8n workflows for predictive inventory turnover and smart notifications.
• Invoicing & Stock Control: Digital invoice generation, multi-warehouse support, supplier tracking, and live inventory reconciliations.
• Executive Dashboard: Interactive data visualization covering sales trends, recurring revenue, and exportable business telemetry.
• Containerized Architecture: Modular deployment powered by Docker, with a robust Django backend and a high-performance Next.js/TypeScript frontend.

item3.title: Payment Management System — Cádiz FC
item3.subtitle: Client Project
item3.description: Web platform that centralizes and automates payment management for a sports team, fully replacing a manual Excel-based workflow. The system receives payment records through a public external form, enables comprehensive management of players, categories, and internal payments, generates reports filtered by category and date range, and sends automated notifications — all from a unified admin panel.
item3.longDescription:
Web platform designed to digitize and automate financial accounting and player records for an athletic sports organization:

• Manual Workflow Replacement: Complete migration from error-prone Excel spreadsheets to a centralized, cloud-native portal.
• Public Payment Form: External portal allowing players and sponsors to submit payment receipts quickly and securely.
• Unified Administrative Panel: Comprehensive roster management across age divisions, payment reconciliations, and audit trails.
• Filtered Reports & Notifications: Automated generation of financial summaries filtered by category/date and instant payment alerts.

item4.title: Asset Management Module — Odoo
item4.subtitle: Custom ERP Module
item4.description: Custom Odoo ERP module designed to optimize fixed asset inventory, assignment, and maintenance scheduling. It integrates AI processes to analyze asset risk levels and automatically extract structured data from digitized documents, streamlining control via Kanban views and dynamic statistical reports.
item4.longDescription:
Custom Odoo ERP module focused on tracking, preventive maintenance, and valuation of physical and intangible corporate assets:

• Dynamic Kanban Boards: Visual pipeline tracing each asset through lifecycle stages, assigning custody and departmental ownership.
• AI & Document OCR: Automated extraction of structured asset metadata from scanned invoices, contracts, and inspection sheets.
• Scheduled Maintenance: Calendar management for recurring technical audits, depreciations, and maintenance appointments.
• Relational PostgreSQL Engine: Fully normalized data model ensuring high-speed queries and strict transactional integrity in the ERP.

item5.title: GestureFlow
item5.subtitle: Desktop Software — ML & Computer Vision
item5.description: End-to-end real-time hand gesture recognition pipeline for desktop control, combining MediaPipe, LSTM neural networks, and OS-level input control.
item5.longDescription:
Full end-to-end computer vision and deep learning pipeline enabling natural desktop OS control via real-time hand gestures:

• MediaPipe Landmark Tracking: High-accuracy detection of 21 3D hand coordinates using standard low-cost webcam inputs.
• LSTM Recurrent Networks: Custom-trained recurrent neural network specialized in recognizing dynamic, time-series gesture sequences.
• OS Input Emulation: Real-time gesture mapping to EMA-smoothed cursor movements, mouse clicks, and virtual workspace switching.
• CustomTkinter Desktop UI: Dark-themed unified interface integrating data collection, model training, and real-time inference viewports.

item6.title: Kiosgo
item6.subtitle: Local Commerce Web Platform
item6.description: A web platform that allows businesses and entrepreneurs to publish a product catalog so their customers can browse items through a shopping cart and place purchase orders from anywhere. Its standout features are a real-time interactive chat and a map that shows the nearest businesses to you.
item6.longDescription:
Hyperlocal e-commerce web platform connecting neighborhood merchants and local entrepreneurs with nearby customers:

• Digital Showcase & Cart: Interactive merchant storefronts allowing customers to browse items and place purchase orders without intermediaries.
• Real-Time Interactive Chat: Instant two-way messaging for ordering inquiries, delivery coordination, and customer support.
• Geolocation & Interactive Map: Location-aware mapping discovering nearest open shops based on the buyer's real-time coordinates.
• Merchant Management Hub: Dedicated business portal for catalog updates, available stock management, and order fulfillment.

item7.title: Odix
item7.subtitle: Mobile App for Vehicle Management
item7.description: A mobile application that lets you keep a detailed log of your vehicle expenses and a maintenance logbook for all changes made. It includes an AI-powered assistant to audit damages and an interactive map to locate nearby spare parts based on your car or motorcycle model.
item7.longDescription:
Comprehensive automotive mobile app for car and motorcycle owners to track maintenance history and operational costs:

• Digital Maintenance Logbook: Complete service log recording part replacements, oil changes, mileage, and photographic evidence.
• Detailed Expense Tracking: Monitoring fuel consumption, maintenance invoices, and monthly operational expenditure analytics.
• AI Diagnostic Assistant: Intelligent symptom diagnosis matching user-reported issues with probable vehicle faults and troubleshooting tips.
• Parts & Repair Locator: Geo-referenced map finding compatible replacement parts and mechanics for the user's specific make and model.

item8.title: Landing Page — TecnoSoluciones LR
item8.subtitle: Corporate Website
item8.description: Modern corporate landing page designed and developed for TecnoSoluciones LR to showcase enterprise technology services, IT support, and business software solutions. Built with Astro and Svelte to deliver lightning-fast load times, smooth interactivity, and a responsive, highly-optimized architecture.
item8.longDescription:
High-conversion corporate landing page built to present enterprise IT services, software consulting, and technical support:

• Astro & Svelte Architecture: Blazing-fast static generation with minimal client-side JavaScript, achieving optimal Core Web Vitals scores.
• IT Services Catalog: Structured showcase of software solutions, server infrastructure, technical support, and cybersecurity offerings.
• Modern Responsive Aesthetics: High-definition dark aesthetic tailored for all screen sizes with fluid micro-interactions.
• Direct Lead Conversion: Optimized call-to-action buttons and inquiry channels designed for seamless enterprise client acquisition.

a2gateway.title: A2 Gateway — Real-Time Data Pipeline & Sync
a2gateway.subtitle: Go Microservice & Fastify Backend
a2gateway.description: High-performance data synchronization system that inspects internal .dat files from a2 Softway ERP using concurrent Go workers, normalizing records into SQLite databases. Features periodic file polling for change detection, a local server for live logs, a Fastify + TypeScript backend connected to cloud PostgreSQL, Redis caching, Docker deployment, and real-time streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
a2gateway.longDescription:
Data integration and modernization architecture designed to decouple and process legacy .dat file-based systems from a2 Softway ERP in real time:

• Concurrent Go Workers: High-throughput background workers in Go parsing and normalizing raw binary/data .dat file records into local SQLite tables.
• Reactive Change Polling: Low-overhead periodic polling engine monitoring file-system modifications to capture updates and additions in milliseconds.
• Local Server & Live Telemetry: Embedded local service providing real-time streaming logs, sync health metrics, and audit diagnostics.
• In-Memory Caching with Redis: Ultra-fast caching and queuing layer to accelerate sync pipelines and optimize database write throughput.
• Centralized Backend Pipeline: Data pipeline pushing changes to a Fastify and TypeScript backend, centralizing data into cloud PostgreSQL and containerized with Docker.
• Dual-Domain Architecture & SSE: Independent two-way connectivity featuring local ingestion from a2gateway and real-time event broadcasting via Server-Sent Events (SSE) to mobile and web consumers.

tecnoa2.title: TecnoA2 — Mobile Business Management
tecnoa2.subtitle: Cross-Platform Mobile Application
tecnoa2.description: Cross-platform mobile application for Android and iOS built with Flutter and Dart, connecting directly to the a2 Softway ecosystem via the centralized backend. Enables real-time inventory management, client tracking, invoice lookup, and multi-company administration.
tecnoa2.longDescription:
Enterprise mobile application bringing daily business and administrative workflows to Android and iOS mobile devices:

• Cross-Platform Performance: Developed using Flutter and Dart, providing a fast, native-feeling user experience on both phones and tablets.
• Core Enterprise Modules: Features multi-company management, client directories, invoice records, real-time inventory lookup with live quantities, secure login, and administrative controls.
• Real-Time Cloud Sync: Direct integration with the Fastify and PostgreSQL backend, receiving live updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) to ensure inventory and billing numbers are always synchronized.
• Enterprise Workflow Ready: Tailored for sales representatives, warehouse staff, and management for seamless operations on the go.
